The EMS limits the inverters through the PLC box when the battery is full or a generator would fall below minimum load; ramped, not
Power limit and start / stop: Admin role only, and only if the EMS supplier allows remote writes (open point 1); otherwise display
The 11 kV busbar must be live, formed by the battery or a generator; PV cannot energise the busbar.
Inverters trip on their own voltage and frequency protection (anti-islanding).

then Ethernet to SW-MV. The blue'Log XM serves the weather station only.
